deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T14:12Z - Observed p99 latency spike on runtime pool 'wave-3' after 2026-03-17 deploy. Alerting SRE oncall.

sre-bot: Paging olivia (oncall) — high p99 and throughput drop on canary nodes, also increased kernel fallback logs.

olivia (oncall): I'm looking. Can someone paste the canary diff? Which feature flag rolled?

mike (eng-runtime): It's the new mosaic-routing kernel selection change. Canary was 20% traffic to new kernel variant. Logs show repeated `fallback_to_generic_kernel` starting ~T+35s.

jordan (support): CS just flagged a customer running a Dedicated pool seeing timeouts on embeddings requests. They reported 5xxs and retries. Could be related.

olivia (oncall): Copy. Prioritize mitigation. If canary is causing kernel fallback + throughput drop we should flip the feature flag or rollback. Any quick mitigation that doesn't require full rollback?

mike (eng-runtime): We can flip the feature flag `mosaic-routing` to false for prod canary cohorts. Command: ```ops-cli feature-flags set mosaic-routing false --scope=canary --env=prod```

ops-cli: Executed `feature-flags set mosaic-routing false --scope=canary --env=prod` by olivia. Flag propagation started.

sre-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature flag flip detected. Traffic rebalancing in progress. Expect rollback to generic kernel for new sessions.

olivia (oncall): Monitoring metrics. p99 trending down but throughput still ~30% lower on wave-3. Kernel fallback counts dropping. Any session affinity / batching interactions to be aware of?

mike (eng-runtime): We observed microbatch windows shrinking due to repeated fallback; that reduced batch sizes and throughput. There's an eviction loop on KV pool for nodes that hit fallback frequently. We're currently increasing batch_window temporarily to 50ms as a mitigation: ```curl -X POST https://ops-api.local/configs -d '{"batch_window_ms":50}'```

ops-cli: Batch window override applied to wave-3 nodes.

sarah (product): Do we have customer impact numbers? Jordan, can you confirm which customers saw errors and whether any SLA breaches?

jordan (support): Two enterprise customers reported elevated error rates between 14:12 and 14:20 UTC. No billed SLA breach yet but retries increased. I'm drafting a notification.

olivia (oncall): Good. We're keeping canary disabled for now. Mike, can you start a partial rollback of the mosaic-routing kernel for dedicated pools too? I'd rather roll back the runtime change across canary/dedicated than full deploy revert.

mike (eng-runtime): Initiating kernel variant removal for dedicated pools and forcing stable kernel affinity. Commands: ```kubectl -n runtime set env deployment/runtime-pool-dedicated KERNEL_VARIANT=stable && /usr/local/bin/runtime-admin reload-config --pool dedicated```

mike (eng-runtime): Done. Changes applied, pods are cycling. Watching for errors.

sre-bot: Pods cycling observed. Health checks passing for restarted pods.

olivia (oncall): Monitoring dashboards: p99 back to baseline on canary, dedicated throughput recovering but some KV cache misses remain. We'll keep elevated batch_window until morning handoff.

jordan (support): Sent customer note: short message explaining we identified a runtime issue after a deploy, mitigation applied, rolling back kernel variant, monitoring. No escalation requests yet.

sarah (product): Thanks. Please include that we flipped the feature flag and are doing a targeted rollback; we'll follow up with a postmortem.

mike (eng-runtime): Logging shows a non-deterministic race in kernel selection when workload shapes include very short seq lengths + high concurrency. That combination made the new kernel/quant path thrash caches. I'll open an RFC bug/PR with logs.

olivia (oncall): For now summary: canary flag flip + dedicated kernel rollback + batch_window override mitigated customer impact. No full rollback of deploy needed. Mike to own bug and postmortem. Jordan to consolidate customer comms. Sarah to coordinate internal comms.

mike (eng-runtime): I'll take postmortem. Expect initial draft within 48h. Root cause hypothesis and reproducer steps in the ticket.

olivia (oncall): Handing to morning oncall (mike) for follow-up. Leaving this thread open but marking as resolved for paging. If anything regresses ping me @olivia. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident note: Incident created 5512346789. Severity: Sev2 -> reduced after mitigations. Assigned to mike (eng-runtime) for RCA.

ops-cli: Action log: [5512346798] feature-flag flip, [5512346842] batch_window override, [5512346895] kernel rollback on dedicated, [5512347050] health checks green.

olivia (oncall): Thanks team. Jordan - please paste customer reply here once received so we can close loop.

jordan (support): Customer A acked, Customer B asked for ETA on fix; we've promised an update after the RCA. I'll add to the support ticket.

mike (eng-runtime): Noted. Will include ETA and mitigation plan in RCA.

sre-bot: Closing paging alert. Thread remains for coordination and postmortem edits.

olivia (oncall): closing my rotation note — handing off full postmortem edits to mike.
